# 1 Enoch Chapter 35 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 1 Enoch Chapter 35 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 35:1 — "as in the case of the former portals" vs. "in the same manner as" vs. "just like those I had seen"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "as in the case of the former portals of the north" | Literal comparative phrase |
| LOGOS | "in the same manner as the former portals in the north" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "just like those I had seen in the north" | Informal; "I had seen" adds first-person recall |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "in the same manner as the former portals in the north." This is a clean formal comparison that preserves the author's cross-reference to chapter 34. EMET's "as in the case of" is verbose; PNEUMA's "I had seen" adds a first-person element not in the Ge'ez at this point.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Note: Chapter 35 has only one verse, so disagreements are necessarily limited. The single substantive issue is the comparative phrase above.*

---
